classification.name: TermType
classification.description: Type of a business glossary term, as defined in DG-GDL-001 chapter 3.

tags.SubjectArea: Grouping used to navigate; carries no data itself.
tags.BusinessObject: A thing with its own identity and life cycle.
tags.Characteristic: A property that describes a business object.
tags.Role: A shared object seen from one business context.
tags.Measure: A quantity the business reads, with unit and aggregation.
tags.Classification: An official or managed list of codes.
tags.Identifier: A code that identifies one instance.

glossaries.name: Shared Business Vocabulary
glossaries.description: Business concepts reused by several domains: parties, locations, time and statistical classifications. Domain glossaries link to these terms instead of redefining them.

glossaries.name: Population and Households
glossaries.description: Concepts used to describe the resident population, households, vital events, names, labour, education and living conditions.

glossaries.name: Enterprises and Economy
glossaries.description: Concepts used to describe enterprises, their demography, prices and economic activity.

glossaries.name: Mobility and Road Safety
glossaries.description: Concepts used to describe road accidents, their casualties and the vehicles involved.

glossaries.name: Buildings and Real Estate
glossaries.description: Concepts used to describe the building stock, dwellings, land and the real estate market.
